purpose: Universe-specific generation constraints discovered during visual QA. These constraints remove text, copied symbols and lore drift without replacing the authoritative environment or character references.

productionConstraints: Keep the lead strictly as a Death Star trench-run Rebel pilot in every intro and victory frame; the blue lightsaber must remain switched off and clipped at the belt, never held, drawn or activated.
Never draw an Imperial, Rebel or franchise emblem. Use only an original asymmetric greeble disc or abstract mechanical hatch with no resemblance to a known crest.
All control panels and helmet markings must be completely blank abstract color blocks: no 0, O, letters, numerals, labels, microtype or pseudo-writing.

Any panic-mask motif must be a visibly original slapstick parody with different eye, mouth and outer-contour proportions; never reproduce the proprietary Ghostface mask silhouette or use it as a logo.
Telephones, VHS cases and keypads must be blank simplified props with no numbers, letters, labels, logos or pseudo-writing.

Do not draw a retail doll package, product box front, printed carton, shelf label or toy branding anywhere. Use only an unlabeled open wooden toy chest, loose doll parts, torn fabric and domestic props.
Keep the KO sequence effect-only as an abstract fractured heart or blank voodoo-energy focus; no hair, head, doll, character or body fragment may appear in that row.

Tiffany carries one identical plain kitchen knife in the same dominant hand throughout all eight pose cells. Keep its complete blade at or below shoulder height and inside the cell guard; never raise it overhead, swap it, duplicate it, holster it or introduce another weapon.

Keep Tiffany in one consistent unmirrored three-quarter orientation throughout both pose rows. The knife-bearing arm and the complete knife must remain on the viewer-right side of her silhouette in all eight cells and must never cross to viewer-left; use only the viewer-left free hand and body posture for celebration.

Every delivery crate and cargo prop must be completely blank red material with plain white corner bands only. Never draw O2 or any oxygen notation, letter, number, chemical symbol, label or pseudo-writing.
Keep the KO sequence effect-only as abstract red-cell membrane energy and fragments; no cap, hair, crate, character or body part may enter that row.

Use the original Interdimensional Garage Scientist Echo design only: a generic elderly animated scientist with altered facial geometry and irregular cyan hair, never an exact Rick Sanchez face, expression or frame recreation.
All gadgets, containers and laboratory props must be closed or blank, with no drink action, readable interface, letters, numerals, labels or pseudo-writing.

Keep Frank completely unarmed in all eight intro and victory cells. Never draw, add, remove, swap or raise a toothpick, condiment cap, utensil, weapon or carried prop; use only empty-hand gestures and body posture.

The four portal cells must read strictly from left to right as a small dormant supermarket-aperture focus with an open transparent center, early opening energy, one fully open peak portal, then sparse collapse and dissipation. Never place the fully open or galaxy-filled peak in the first cell.
All packages, cartons, aisle fixtures and HUD materials remain completely blank abstract color blocks with no product mark, letter, number, label or pseudo-writing.

Keep Toaster as the exact same unarmed appliance identity in all eight pose cells, with the same side lever, two slots, cord length and plug silhouette visible and unchanged. Never detach, hide, duplicate, transform or replace the cord, plug or lever, and never invent a slash weapon or carried prop.
The four portal cells must read strictly from left to right as dormant appliance-electric focus, early opening, one fully open peak aperture, then sparse collapse and dissipation.
Every appliance plate, control surface and workshop material stays blank with no brand, letter, number, label, dial text or pseudo-writing.

Tai and Agumon must remain the same complete duo in every intro and victory cell; the compact Digivice screen stays dark and completely blank, and data effects contain no binary digits, letters or pseudo-code.

Use one original unbranded double-barrel super-shotgun silhouette as the exact same carried firearm in all eight pose cells. Keep the wrist Doomblade folded and unchanged as part of the armor; never replace either item with a pistol, rifle, chainsaw or raised blade.
Armor plates and HUD machinery must have only blank abstract material blocks: no DOOM mark, letters, numerals, rune text, logos or pseudo-writing.

The Vault Dweller carries one exact original compact modular rifle in the same dominant hand throughout all eight pose cells; never become unarmed or swap to a pistol, long rifle, melee weapon or duplicate gun.

Keep the Pip-Boy fixed on the left forearm with a dark blank screen and abstract color blocks only. Draw no Vault number, Vault-Tec logo, letters, numerals, labels, radiation emblem or pseudo-writing anywhere.

Commander Shepard carries one exact original unbranded compact futuristic assault rifle in the same dominant hand throughout all eight pose cells; never holster it, become unarmed, swap weapon class, add a grenade or deploy a blade.
Armor, ships, stations and HUD panels use blank geometric color blocks only. Never draw N7, Systems Alliance, Spectre or franchise marks, letters, numerals, logos, labels or pseudo-writing.

Solid Snake carries one exact original unbranded suppressed compact assault rifle in the same dominant hand throughout all eight pose cells; never become unarmed or swap to a pistol, knife, launcher or different rifle.

All suit patches, radar panels and machinery stay completely blank. The KO focus is an abstract fractured radar pulse without a clock face, dial, letters, numerals, unit emblem, logo or pseudo-writing.

Kael Venn keeps the same complete pair of project-canonical crescent minute-blades, one in each hand, throughout all eight pose cells. Never hide, merge, duplicate, transform, discard or replace either blade, and keep both below shoulder height.
Clock faces use plain hands and unlabeled tick marks only. Every paper, book, instrument and HUD plate is blank material with no letters, numerals, formulas, labels or pseudo-writing.
